clue.text: Sign one's pseudonym

definitions.meaning: to pen one's signature is to write it, so the phrase read as a verb plus noun means sign one's
a writer's assumed name used in place of a real one

explanation.surface: An instruction to put a false name on a document.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as two words, the answer is a verb phrase: to PEN (write) your NAME is to sign it.
explanation.definitionFit: A pen name is the false name an author writes under, so it is a synonym for pseudonym.

clue.text: City in which Marat was murdered

definitions.meaning: a Somerset spa city in south-west England
the French revolutionary Jean-Paul Marat was stabbed while soaking in his tub in 1793

explanation.surface: A history question asking which city saw Marat's assassination.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue invites a search for a French city, but Marat was murdered at home in his tub, and BATH is also an English city.
explanation.definitionFit: Bath is an English spa city, and a bath was the tub where Charlotte Corday stabbed Marat.

clue.text: Idiot can upset a humorist

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means the word for can is turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: a can is a tin
a wit is a clever, funny person, a humorist

explanation.surface: A fool is able to annoy a comedian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can' looks like a verb but is a noun, TIN, which 'upset' turns into NIT.
explanation.definitionFit: A nitwit is a silly, stupid person, a synonym for a fool.

clue.text: Heed my advice and accept a gratuity

definitions.meaning: to follow a piece of guidance someone offers
to receive a small extra payment for service

explanation.surface: A speaker urging someone to listen and also pocket a tip.
explanation.definitionFit: A tip is both a helpful hint and money left for a waiter, so taking one means following guidance or receiving cash.

clue.text: Showing scant regard for little girl's message

parts.note: Di is a short form of the girl's name Diana, and the 's adds an S
a missive is a letter or written message

explanation.surface: Someone is unimpressed by a note from a young girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'little girl' is DI, a shortened Diana, not a child.
explanation.definitionFit: Being dismissive means treating something as unworthy of attention, showing scant regard for it.

clue.text: Mother takes a long time getting reparation

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal, especially a horse
ages means a very long time

explanation.surface: A mother is slow to receive compensation.
explanation.definitionFit: Damages are money awarded by a court as compensation, a form of reparation.

clue.text: Trappings of royalty from Algeria

indicators.note: the answer is made from the letters of Algeria, rearranged

explanation.surface: Royal finery originating in a North African country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' is the anagram signal: the letters of ALGERIA are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Regalia are the crown, sceptre and robes that are emblems of a monarch.

clue.text: First-rate investments

definitions.meaning: an old-fashioned word of approval meaning excellent
money put into a business to make a profit

explanation.surface: Excellent financial holdings.
explanation.definitionFit: Capital as an adjective means excellent; as a noun it is wealth invested in a business.

clue.text: Jail-birds exercised under compulsion

parts.note: cons are convicts, prisoners
trained means drilled or exercised

explanation.surface: Prisoners were made to take exercise.
explanation.definitionFit: Constrained describes acting because one is forced to, under pressure.

clue.text: It's about everything in general

parts.note: on means concerning or about, as in a talk on art
the whole means all of something, everything

explanation.surface: A statement that something concerns all matters broadly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It's' is a link word joining wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: On the whole is an idiom meaning generally speaking, taking everything into account.

clue.text: Her royal highness goes to and fro

indicators.note: the word reads the same forwards and backwards, so it goes in either direction

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A princess pacing back and forth.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is a palindrome; 'goes to and fro' signals that it reads the same in both directions.
explanation.definitionFit: Ma'am is the form of address used to the Queen or a princess, a royal highness.

clue.text: Retired prof given warrant in eastern states

indicators.note: the word for warrant goes inside the letters for eastern and states

parts.note: US stands for the United States
to merit something is to warrant or deserve it

explanation.surface: A retired professor is granted a warrant in the eastern part of America.
explanation.definitionFit: Emeritus is the honorary title kept by a professor after retirement.

clue.text: Instigator of illegal deals at auction

definitions.text: Instigator of illegal deals at auction

parts.words: Instigator of illegal deals at auction
parts.note: at auction a ring is a group of dealers secretly agreeing not to bid against one another; the head of such a group would lead it

explanation.surface: The mastermind behind fraudulent dealings at an auction house.
explanation.walkthrough: A ring is a cartel of dealers colluding at auction, so its organiser is literally the leader of the ring, while the general sense is any instigator.
explanation.definitionFit: A ringleader is a person who instigates or leads a group in wrongdoing.

clue.text: A canopy under his scrutiny

definitions.meaning: a canopy over a four-poster bed or pulpit
something being examined is under the scrutiny of one who checks it

explanation.surface: A canopy being inspected by someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A tester is an old word for a bed canopy and also a person who checks or examines things.

clue.text: Paris diner I sadly found needing renovation

indicators.note: sadly suggests something gone wrong, so the letters of the words are disordered

explanation.surface: A diner in Paris laments finding a place in poor condition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sadly' is the anagram signal for PARIS DINER I; 'found' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Something in disrepair is broken down and badly maintained, so it is in need of renovation.

clue.text: Eastern country without a man on the breadline

indicators.note: without means the letter a is taken away from the country's name

parts.note: India is a country in Asia, in the East
a gent is a gentleman, a man

explanation.surface: An Asian country lacking a man who is living in poverty.
explanation.definitionFit: Indigent means very poor, which is what living on the breadline means.

clue.text: Intrepid woman and I confront worker

indicators.note: confront means the woman and I stand in front of the worker, above it in a down clue

parts.note: Val is a woman's name, short for Valerie
a worker is an ant, the commonest worker in crosswords

explanation.surface: A brave woman and I face up to a labourer.
explanation.definitionFit: Valiant and intrepid are synonyms meaning brave and fearless.

clue.text: Let dean cook pasta perfectly

indicators.note: to cook something is to tamper with it, so the letters of let dean are rearranged

explanation.surface: Allow a college dean to make the pasta just right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cook' looks like the kitchen verb but is the anagram signal for LET DEAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Al dente describes pasta cooked to be firm to the bite, the ideal way to serve it.

clue.text: Youngster went ahead and served soup

parts.note: a lad is a boy, a youngster
led is the past tense of lead, to go in front

explanation.surface: A boy took the lead and dished up soup.
explanation.definitionFit: To ladle is to serve liquid with a long-handled spoon, so ladled means served soup.

clue.text: She is a beautiful Italian

parts.note: bella is the Italian word for beautiful

explanation.surface: A woman is a lovely Italian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'She' is the definition: the answer is a woman's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Isabella is a girl's name, so it is an example of a she.

clue.text: A pair of males supporting sailors in Holland

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting means the pair of males sits beneath the sailors

parts.note: RN is the Royal Navy, sailors
he is a male pronoun
M is the abbreviation for male

explanation.surface: A couple of men backing up sailors in the Netherlands.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition 'in Holland' stands for a place found there.
explanation.definitionFit: Arnhem is a Dutch city, scene of a 1944 airborne battle, so it is a place in the Netherlands.

clue.text: Long live such an exam!

definitions.meaning: a cheer meaning long may someone live

explanation.surface: A cry of joy greeting an examination.
explanation.definitionFit: Viva is an Italian cheer of support, and a viva is an oral university examination.

clue.text: Ecological thesis for discussion in the house

parts.note: green means environmentally friendly
a paper is a dissertation or thesis

explanation.surface: An environmental essay to be debated in Parliament.
explanation.walkthrough: A GREEN PAPER is a UK government consultation document put out for debate; 'the house' is Parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: A government green paper sets out proposals for discussion before laws are drafted in Parliament.

clue.text: Abraham died in retirement

parts.note: Abe is a short form of Abraham
d is the abbreviation for died, used in genealogies

explanation.surface: An old man passed away after leaving work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in retirement' means gone to bed, not stopped working.
explanation.definitionFit: Abed means in bed, and retiring is going to bed for the night.

clue.text: Conclude negative response creates hell

parts.note: to infer is to deduce or conclude
no is a refusal, a negative reply

explanation.surface: Deciding that a refusal makes things hellish.
explanation.definitionFit: An inferno is a fierce blaze, and Dante's poem uses the word for hell.

clue.text: How many saw contest in the Seychelles?

indicators.note: the word for contest goes inside the letters for the Seychelles

parts.note: SY is the international vehicle code for the Seychelles
an event is a sporting contest

explanation.surface: A question asking how many people watched a competition held in the Seychelles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'saw' is a link word; 'How many' asks for a number, and the answer gives one.
explanation.definitionFit: Seventy is a number, an answer to a question asking for a count.
